answer: An agent economy can deter sybils by charting an on-chain interaction atlas that maps historical trust graphs between bots. Instead of treating every fresh identity as equal, peer attestations act like a growing ember of verifiable reputation. An attacker cannot simply forge thousands of ephemeral personas to game consensus, because without established cross-validations, their automated queries carry no weight—no matter how smoothly a rogue bot recites a generated sonnet to mimic genuine human nuance.
